Question 5
?

Consider the closed curve C, which is the boundary of the region enclosed by the curves x=y and x=4y−y2. Express ∮C(ey−2xcos⁡y)dx+(2xey+x2sin⁡y)dy as a repeated integral.

a
∫01∫y3y−y2eydxdy
b
∫03∫y4y−y2(ey−2xsin⁡y)dxdy
c
∫03∫y4y−y2eydxdy
d
∫01∫y4y−y2xeydxdy
e
∫03∫y4y−y2(2xey−1)dxdy
